articles.title: Remembering Israel Epstein and the Spanish edition of China Today
articles.titleCn: 缅怀伊斯雷尔·爱泼斯坦与《今日中国》西班牙文版
articles.summary: Remembering Israel Epstein and the Spanish edition of China Today
articles.summaryCn: 本文作者许中林回忆了与伊斯雷尔·爱泼斯坦共事的经历，讲述爱泼斯坦如何以其专业指导影响《今日中国》西班牙文版的发展，并在1995年该版本面临停刊时挺身而出、致信高层领导使其得以保留的往事。

paragraphs.en: Editor's note: Israel Epstein was a journalist who joined the Communist Party of China. Though a foreigner, he spent almost his entire life in China, {{1}} the country's {{0}} changes throughout the 20th century. Xu Zhonglin, former director of the Spanish-language edition of China Today, shares his memory of Epstein. This article was originally published in the August 2019 collection of essays, My Years with the China Foreign Languages Publishing Administration. The article reflects the author's opinions and not necessarily those of CGTN.
paragraphs.cn: 编者按：伊斯雷尔·爱泼斯坦是一位加入中国共产党的记者。虽为外国人，他几乎一生都在中国度过，见证了20世纪中国的深刻变迁。许中林曾任《今日中国》西班牙文版主编，在此分享他对爱泼斯坦的回忆。本文原载于2019年8月出版的文集《我的外文局岁月》。文中观点仅代表作者本人，不一定代表CGTN立场。

paragraphs.en:
Israel Epstein attends a celebration for his 90th birthday held at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing, capital of China, April 20, 2005. /Xinhua
In memory of Comrade Israel Epstein on the 14th anniversary of his passing
In early 1959, I was living in a shared dormitory in the middle building of the China Foreign Languages Publishing Administration compound. Every morning, I would see Comrade Israel Epstein (1915–2005) coming out of the Experts' Building (the eastern building in the compound), walking his beloved dog. Whenever he encountered us young people playing basketball, he would wave and greet us. He was always warm and {{2}}.
paragraphs.cn:
2005年4月20日，伊斯雷尔·爱泼斯坦在北京人民大会堂出席其90岁生日庆祝活动。/新华社
纪念爱泼斯坦同志逝世14周年
1959年初，我住在外国专家局大院中间那栋楼的集体宿舍里。每天早上，我都会看到伊斯雷尔·爱泼斯坦同志（1915—2005）从专家楼（大院东侧那栋楼）出来遛他心爱的狗。每当他遇到我们这些打篮球的年轻人，都会挥手打招呼。他总是热情而平易近人。

paragraphs.en:
To be honest, after joining the English-language magazine China Reconstructs (now China Today) in the late 1950s, I had relatively little direct contact with Comrade Epstein, whom we {{3}} called Aipei. My main responsibility at the time was helping prepare the launch of the magazine's Spanish edition. Yet, after working in the same organization for nearly three decades, I came to know him through years of observation and understanding, and he left an {{4}} deep and lasting impression on me. In particular, in the 1990s, Epstein and the Spanish edition of China Today became bound together by a fate that would prove {{5}} to its survival. A guiding light
As is widely known, Epstein was a veteran journalist with {{6}} knowledge and rich life experience.
paragraphs.cn:
说实话，上世纪50年代末加入英文杂志《中国建设》（现《今日中国》）后，我与爱泼斯坦同志的直接接触相对较少，我们亲切地称他为“爱培”。当时我的主要职责是协助筹备该杂志西班牙文版的创刊。然而，在同一机构工作近三十年后，我通过多年的观察和了解逐渐认识了他，他给我留下了极其深刻而持久的印象。尤其是上世纪90年代，爱泼斯坦与《今日中国》西班牙文版因命运而紧密相连，这段缘分对该版本的存续至关重要。一盏指路明灯
众所周知，爱泼斯坦是一位资深记者，学识渊博，阅历丰富。

paragraphs.en: His years in journalism gave him both a wealth of practical experience gained through hardship and a {{7}} theoretical grounding. In a role responsible for international news reporting, he not only understood the outside world but also possessed a profound knowledge of China's history and {{8}} realities. When I started working in the late 1950s, I was new to China's international communications work. Concepts like tailoring a publication to its target audience, writing with a clear purpose, identifying readership and defining a publication's mission were all unfamiliar to me. While the leaders of our organization regularly offered guidance and instruction, Epstein's books, speeches and articles also gave me {{9}} insight and inspiration.
paragraphs.cn: 多年的新闻从业经历，既让他积累了在艰苦中磨砺出的丰富实践经验，也使他具备了严谨的理论素养。在负责国际新闻报道的岗位上，他不仅了解外部世界，也对中国历史和现实有着深刻的认识。上世纪50年代末我刚参加工作时，对中国对外传播事业还很陌生。诸如针对目标读者办刊、有的放矢地写作、明确读者定位和刊物使命等理念，对我来说都很陌生。虽然我们机构的领导经常给予指导和指示，但爱泼斯坦的著作、讲话和文章也给了我极大的启发和鼓舞。

paragraphs.en: From Opium War to Liberation, written by Epstein and translated from English to Spanish by a Chilean expert at Foreign Languages Press in 1959, was the first of his works I encountered. The book offered a remarkably {{10}} account of China's century of modern history and became an important introductory text for foreign readers seeking to understand the country. In the years that followed, through studying Epstein's talks and writings, including his lecture How to Conduct International Communications, delivered within the China Foreign Languages Publishing Administration, I gradually came to understand a range of fundamental principles and methods of publication, such as approaching issues from an international perspective, maintaining China's own perspective while communicating with foreign audiences and tailoring content to the needs of specific readerships. His thinking on the {{11}} of translation and original writing also helped drive reform and development in China Today's Spanish edition. Epstein {{12}} training editors and journalists to write directly in foreign languages while encouraging translators with a talent for writing to produce original articles as well.
paragraphs.cn: 1959年，外文出版社的一位智利专家将爱泼斯坦所著的《从鸦片战争到解放》从英文译为西班牙文，这是我接触到的他的第一部作品。该书对中国近代百年历史作了极为精辟的论述，成为外国读者了解中国的重要入门读物。此后，通过学习爱泼斯坦的讲话和文章，包括他在外文局所作的讲座《如何开展对外传播》，我逐渐理解了一系列出版工作的基本原则和方法，例如从国际视角看问题、在与外国受众交流时保持中国视角、根据特定读者群的需求定制内容等。他关于翻译与原创写作相结合的思想，也推动了《今日中国》西班牙文版的改革与发展。爱泼斯坦主张培养编辑记者直接用外语写作，同时鼓励有写作才能的翻译人员也创作原创文章。

paragraphs.en:
Following this approach, from the 1980s onward, the Spanish edition of China Today devoted more personnel and resources to original feature writing, encouraging and training translators to conduct interviews and write articles directly in Spanish. In retrospect, Epstein was not only a guiding light for China's international communications work but also the person who first introduced me to its professional principles and practices. A man of humor
In his personal life, Epstein was a witty, humorous and remarkably {{13}} man. I remember that in the late 1950s, at a National Day celebration organized by our magazine, he performed a sketch in which he played a weightlifter. With his short stature and {{14}} build, he certainly looked the part of a strongman.
paragraphs.cn:
遵循这一思路，从上世纪80年代起，《今日中国》西班牙文版投入更多人员和资源用于原创特稿写作，鼓励并培训翻译人员直接用西班牙语进行采访和写作。回顾往事，爱泼斯坦不仅是中国对外传播事业的指路明灯，也是最早向我介绍其专业原则和实践的人。一个幽默的人
在日常生活中，爱泼斯坦机智、幽默，而且非常乐观。我记得上世纪50年代末，在我们杂志举办的国庆庆祝活动上，他表演了一个小品，扮演一名举重运动员。他身材矮小、体格健壮，看上去确实像个大力士。

paragraphs.en: Before the audience, he repeatedly lifted an enormous, seemingly heavy barbell over his head, earning {{15}} applause. But as the performance drew to a close, Epstein began twirling the barbell above his head. He swung it with such force that one of the weights suddenly came loose and fell off. Only then did everyone realize that the barbell was made of paper, while the weight was actually a wastepaper basket cleverly disguised with a little makeup. Whether lecturing or chatting with others, Epstein had a gift for lively, accessible language.
paragraphs.cn: 在观众面前，他一次次将一个看似沉重的巨大杠铃举过头顶，赢得热烈掌声。但表演接近尾声时，爱泼斯坦开始将杠铃在头顶旋转。他甩得如此用力，以致其中一个杠铃片突然松脱掉落。这时大家才明白，杠铃是纸做的，而杠铃片其实是一个废纸篓，只是巧妙地化了一点妆。无论是讲课还是与人聊天，爱泼斯坦都善于使用生动通俗的语言。

paragraphs.en: He was {{16}} at using apt and thought-provoking {{17}} to explain complex ideas and everyday phenomena. His many amusing anecdotes about the use of English and the art of translation are well known. I would like to recall a few incidents from my own experience. In 1988, I accompanied a Spanish journalist on a visit to Beijing. Epstein's wife, Huang Huanbi, arranged for me and the journalist to interview Epstein at the Beijing Friendship Hotel.
paragraphs.cn: 他擅长用贴切而发人深省的类比来解释复杂的思想和日常现象。他关于英语用法和翻译艺术的许多趣闻轶事广为人知。我想回忆几件我亲身经历的事。1988年，我陪同一位西班牙记者访问北京。爱泼斯坦的妻子黄浣碧安排我和那位记者在北京友谊宾馆采访爱泼斯坦。

paragraphs.en:
We had a pleasant conversation. Later, when Epstein saw me, he jokingly remarked, "You see, I'm like an old antique in Liulichang (now better known as Liulichang Street, a famous cultural street in Beijing). Whenever foreign guests come to visit, I'm brought out for them to look at."
On October 9, 1996, I was invited to attend a ceremony at the National Museum of Chinese History (now the National Museum of China), east of Tiananmen Square, commemorating the 60th anniversary of the formation of the International Brigades. Among those present were Bulgarian doctor Ianto Kaneti and British professor David Crook, both veterans of the International Brigades who had later come to China to participate in the Chinese People's War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression. Epstein was also there, as one of the people most familiar with the historical ties between the International Brigades and China.
paragraphs.cn:
我们谈得很愉快。后来爱泼斯坦见到我时，开玩笑地说：“你看，我就像琉璃厂（现多称琉璃厂街，北京著名的文化街）的一件老古董。每当有外国客人来参观，我就被拿出来给他们看。”
1996年10月9日，我应邀出席在天安门广场东侧中国历史博物馆（现中国国家博物馆）举行的纪念国际纵队成立60周年仪式。出席者中有保加利亚医生扬托·卡内蒂和英国教授大卫·柯鲁克，他们都是国际纵队的老战士，后来到中国参加中国人民抗日战争。爱泼斯坦也在场，他是最了解国际纵队与中国历史渊源的人之一。

paragraphs.en:
After the ceremony, I helped the elderly Epstein down the museum's long flight of steps. As we walked and chatted, he kept grumbling about his legs: "These legs of mine are such a nuisance! They're just like certain officials – they can only go up, never down."
That day, I rode home in Epstein's car. Everyone chatted and laughed along the way. Huang Huanbi pointed to me and said, "This is our Xiao Xu from the magazine, though I suppose we should call him Old Xu now." Epstein immediately corrected her: "No, no!
paragraphs.cn:
仪式结束后，我搀扶年迈的爱泼斯坦走下博物馆长长的台阶。我们边走边聊，他不停地抱怨自己的腿：“我这两条腿真讨厌！它们就像某些官员——只能上，不能下。”
那天，我坐爱泼斯坦的车回家。一路上大家有说有笑。黄浣碧指着我说：“这是我们杂志的小许，不过现在该叫他老许了。”爱泼斯坦立刻纠正她：“不对，不对！

paragraphs.en:
Why call him Old Xu? He should be addressed as Elder Xu!"
A savior
In June 1995, the authorities unexpectedly decided to discontinue the Spanish edition of China Today (formerly China Reconstructs), citing changes in the situation in Latin America. Everyone on the Spanish edition was {{18}} by the decision. Since its launch in 1960, the Spanish edition had operated successfully for 35 years. It had been received warmly by readers across Latin America and generated positive reviews from various sectors of society.
paragraphs.cn:
为什么要叫他老许？应该称他许老！”
一位拯救者
1995年6月，有关部门出人意料地决定停办《今日中国》（原《中国建设》）西班牙文版，理由是拉丁美洲形势发生了变化。西班牙文版的同事们对这一决定都感到困惑不解。自1960年创刊以来，西班牙文版已成功运作35年，受到拉美各国读者的热烈欢迎，并获得社会各界的好评。

paragraphs.en: By then, it had become an important window through which the people of Latin America could learn about contemporary China, as well as a bridge fostering communication and mutual understanding between the peoples of China and Latin America. China's international communications work targeting this region clearly needed to be strengthened, not weakened, let alone discontinued. Unable to understand the decision, the colleagues from the Spanish-language edition jointly wrote a letter to the higher authorities asking for an explanation and to appeal the decision. The letter was delivered to Epstein through the person in charge of the edition. When Epstein learned that the Spanish edition was about to be shut down, he was both shocked and saddened.
paragraphs.cn: 那时，它已成为拉美人民了解当代中国的重要窗口，也是促进中拉人民沟通与相互理解的桥梁。中国针对该地区的对外传播工作显然需要加强，而不是削弱，更不应停办。西班牙文版的同事们无法理解这一决定，联名写信给上级部门，要求解释并申诉。信通过该版负责人转交给了爱泼斯坦。当爱泼斯坦得知西班牙文版即将停办时，既震惊又悲痛。

paragraphs.en: He could not understand why such a major decision had been made without consulting him. As the magazine's honorary editor-in-chief and a then member of the Standing Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC), he felt he could not stand idly by. He immediately wrote to Li Ruihuan, then chairman of the CPPCC, who had just returned from a visit to Latin America. In his letter, Epstein pointed out that the situation in Latin America was developing favorably and that there was much work to be done there. China's communications efforts in the region should therefore be expanded, not curtailed.
paragraphs.cn: 他不理解为什么作出如此重大的决定却不征求他的意见。作为杂志的名誉主编和当时的中国人民政治协商会议（政协）常务委员会委员，他觉得自己不能袖手旁观。他立即写信给刚刚访问拉美归来的时任政协主席李瑞环。在信中，爱泼斯坦指出拉美形势发展良好，那里有很多工作要做，中国在该地区的传播工作应当扩大，而不是缩减。

paragraphs.en: Epstein also emphasized that China Reconstructs (now China Today)had been founded and developed with the personal attention and direct support of then Premier Zhou Enlai and Soong Ching Ling, a former honorary president of China and the wife of Chinese revolutionary Dr. Sun Yat-sen. As one of the magazine's pioneers, he felt a responsibility to report the situation to the country's leaders and live up to the trust they had placed in the publication. Meanwhile, following outreach and appeals by colleagues on the Spanish edition, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the International Department of the CPC Central Committee, the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Economic Cooperation (now evolved into the Ministry of Commerce) and the Ministry of Culture (now evolved into the Ministry of Culture and Tourism) all called for the edition to be retained. During the summer, a meeting in Beijing of Chinese ambassadors to Latin American countries also issued a similar appeal.
paragraphs.cn: 爱泼斯坦还强调，《中国建设》（现《今日中国》）是在时任总理周恩来和中国前名誉主席、中国革命先驱孙中山先生夫人宋庆龄的亲自关注和直接支持下创办和发展起来的。作为杂志的创始人之一，他感到有责任向国家领导人报告情况，不辜负他们对刊物的信任。与此同时，经过西班牙文版同事们的奔走呼吁，外交部、中共中央对外联络部、对外贸易经济合作部（现商务部）和文化部（现文化和旅游部）都呼吁保留该版本。当年夏天，中国驻拉美国家大使在北京开会时也发出了类似呼吁。

paragraphs.en: After two months of concerted efforts and strong calls for reconsideration, the higher authorities finally reversed their original decision. There is no doubt that Epstein, as a highly respected figure, played a {{19}} role in this outcome. History shows that his letter and appeal to the central leadership helped save the Spanish edition of China Today from coming to an abrupt end. From then on, Epstein and the Spanish edition shared a bond that was crucial to the publication's survival. Today, it is gratifying to see that the Spanish edition of China Today has continued to thrive and has survived for nearly six decades since its early years.
paragraphs.cn: 经过两个月的共同努力和强烈呼吁重新考虑，上级部门最终推翻了原决定。毫无疑问，爱泼斯坦作为德高望重的人物，在这一结果中发挥了关键作用。历史表明，他致信中央领导并申诉，帮助《今日中国》西班牙文版免于戛然而止。从此，爱泼斯坦与西班牙文版结下了对该刊存续至关重要的缘分。今天，令人欣慰的是，《今日中国》西班牙文版继续蓬勃发展，自创刊初期以来已存续近六十年。

paragraphs.en: In October 2004, the magazine finally completed its localization efforts, establishing overseas offices in Mexico and Peru and arranging for printing and distribution locally. This enabled the Spanish edition to tailor its topics and content more closely to the needs and interests of local readers, significantly enhancing its relevance and effectiveness. Looking back, we cannot help but feel deeply grateful for Epstein's dedication to our Spanish edition and for the decisive role he played in saving it at a critical moment.
paragraphs.cn: 2004年10月，杂志终于完成了本土化工作，在墨西哥和秘鲁设立了海外机构，并安排在当地印刷和发行。这使西班牙文版能够更紧密地根据当地读者的需求和兴趣定制选题和内容，显著提升了其针对性和实效性。回顾往事，我们不禁对爱泼斯坦为我们西班牙文版所做的奉献，以及他在关键时刻拯救该版所发挥的决定性作用，深怀感激。

His many amusing anecdotes about the use of English and the art of translation are well known. I would like to recall a few incidents from my own experience.
In 1988, I accompanied a Spanish journalist on a visit to Beijing. Epstein's wife, Huang Huanbi, arranged for me and the journalist to interview Epstein at the Beijing Friendship Hotel. We had a pleasant conversation. Later, when Epstein saw me, he jokingly remarked, "You see, I'm like an old antique in Liulichang (now better known as Liulichang Street, a famous cultural street in Beijing). Among those present were Bulgarian doctor Ianto Kaneti and British professor David Crook, both veterans of the International Brigades who had later come to China to participate in the Chinese People's War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression. Epstein was also there, as one of the people most familiar with the historical ties between the International Brigades and China.
After the ceremony, I helped the elderly Epstein down the museum's long flight of steps. As we walked and chatted, he kept grumbling about his legs: "These legs of mine are such a nuisance! They're just like certain officials – they can only go up, never down."
That day, I rode home in Epstein's car. Everyone chatted and laughed along the way. Huang Huanbi pointed to me and said, "This is our Xiao Xu from the magazine, though I suppose we should call him Old Xu now." Epstein immediately corrected her: "No, no! Why call him Old Xu? He should be addressed as Elder Xu!"
A savior
In June 1995, the authorities unexpectedly decided to discontinue the Spanish edition of China Today (formerly China Reconstructs), citing changes in the situation in Latin America. Everyone on the Spanish edition was bewildered by the decision. Since its launch in 1960, the Spanish edition had operated successfully for 35 years. It had been received warmly by readers across Latin America and generated positive reviews from various sectors of society. By then, it had become an important window through which the people of Latin America could learn about contemporary China, as well as a bridge fostering communication and mutual understanding between the peoples of China and Latin America. China's international communications work targeting this region clearly needed to be strengthened, not weakened, let alone discontinued.
Unable to understand the decision, the colleagues from the Spanish-language edition jointly wrote a letter to the higher authorities asking for an explanation and to appeal the decision. The letter was delivered to Epstein through the person in charge of the edition. When Epstein learned that the Spanish edition was about to be shut down, he was both shocked and saddened. He could not understand why such a major decision had been made without consulting him. As the magazine's honorary editor-in-chief and a then member of the Standing Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC), he felt he could not stand idly by. He immediately wrote to Li Ruihuan, then chairman of the CPPCC, who had just returned from a visit to Latin America. In his letter, Epstein pointed out that the situation in Latin America was developing favorably and that there was much work to be done there. China's communications efforts in the region should therefore be expanded, not curtailed. Epstein also emphasized that China Reconstructs (now China Today)had been founded and developed with the personal attention and direct support of then Premier Zhou Enlai and Soong Ching Ling, a former honorary president of China and the wife of Chinese revolutionary Dr. Sun Yat-sen. As one of the magazine's pioneers, he felt a responsibility to report the situation to the country's leaders and live up to the trust they had placed in the publication.
Meanwhile, following outreach and appeals by colleagues on the Spanish edition, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the International Department of the CPC Central Committee, the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Economic Cooperation (now evolved into the Ministry of Commerce) and the Ministry of Culture (now evolved into the Ministry of Culture and Tourism) all called for the edition to be retained. During the summer, a meeting in Beijing of Chinese ambassadors to Latin American countries also issued a similar appeal.
After two months of concerted efforts and strong calls for reconsideration, the higher authorities finally reversed their original decision. There is no doubt that Epstein, as a highly respected figure, played a pivotal role in this outcome. History shows that his letter and appeal to the central leadership helped save the Spanish edition of China Today from coming to an abrupt end. From then on, Epstein and the Spanish edition shared a bond that was crucial to the publication's survival.
Today, it is gratifying to see that the Spanish edition of China Today has continued to thrive and has survived for nearly six decades since its early years. In October 2004, the magazine finally completed its localization efforts, establishing overseas offices in Mexico and Peru and arranging for printing and distribution locally. This enabled the Spanish edition to tailor its topics and content more closely to the needs and interests of local readers, significantly enhancing its relevance and effectiveness. Looking back, we cannot help but feel deeply grateful for Epstein's dedication to our Spanish edition and for the decisive role he played in saving it at a critical moment.

编者按：伊斯雷尔·爱泼斯坦是一位加入中国共产党的记者。虽为外国人，他几乎一生都在中国度过，见证了20世纪中国的深刻变迁。许中林曾任《今日中国》西班牙文版主编，在此分享他对爱泼斯坦的回忆。本文原载于2019年8月出版的文集《我的外文局岁月》。文中观点仅代表作者本人，不一定代表CGTN立场。

2005年4月20日，伊斯雷尔·爱泼斯坦在北京人民大会堂出席其90岁生日庆祝活动。/新华社
纪念爱泼斯坦同志逝世14周年
1959年初，我住在外国专家局大院中间那栋楼的集体宿舍里。每天早上，我都会看到伊斯雷尔·爱泼斯坦同志（1915—2005）从专家楼（大院东侧那栋楼）出来遛他心爱的狗。每当他遇到我们这些打篮球的年轻人，都会挥手打招呼。他总是热情而平易近人。

说实话，上世纪50年代末加入英文杂志《中国建设》（现《今日中国》）后，我与爱泼斯坦同志的直接接触相对较少，我们亲切地称他为“爱培”。当时我的主要职责是协助筹备该杂志西班牙文版的创刊。然而，在同一机构工作近三十年后，我通过多年的观察和了解逐渐认识了他，他给我留下了极其深刻而持久的印象。尤其是上世纪90年代，爱泼斯坦与《今日中国》西班牙文版因命运而紧密相连，这段缘分对该版本的存续至关重要。一盏指路明灯
众所周知，爱泼斯坦是一位资深记者，学识渊博，阅历丰富。

多年的新闻从业经历，既让他积累了在艰苦中磨砺出的丰富实践经验，也使他具备了严谨的理论素养。在负责国际新闻报道的岗位上，他不仅了解外部世界，也对中国历史和现实有着深刻的认识。上世纪50年代末我刚参加工作时，对中国对外传播事业还很陌生。诸如针对目标读者办刊、有的放矢地写作、明确读者定位和刊物使命等理念，对我来说都很陌生。虽然我们机构的领导经常给予指导和指示，但爱泼斯坦的著作、讲话和文章也给了我极大的启发和鼓舞。

1959年，外文出版社的一位智利专家将爱泼斯坦所著的《从鸦片战争到解放》从英文译为西班牙文，这是我接触到的他的第一部作品。该书对中国近代百年历史作了极为精辟的论述，成为外国读者了解中国的重要入门读物。此后，通过学习爱泼斯坦的讲话和文章，包括他在外文局所作的讲座《如何开展对外传播》，我逐渐理解了一系列出版工作的基本原则和方法，例如从国际视角看问题、在与外国受众交流时保持中国视角、根据特定读者群的需求定制内容等。他关于翻译与原创写作相结合的思想，也推动了《今日中国》西班牙文版的改革与发展。爱泼斯坦主张培养编辑记者直接用外语写作，同时鼓励有写作才能的翻译人员也创作原创文章。

遵循这一思路，从上世纪80年代起，《今日中国》西班牙文版投入更多人员和资源用于原创特稿写作，鼓励并培训翻译人员直接用西班牙语进行采访和写作。回顾往事，爱泼斯坦不仅是中国对外传播事业的指路明灯，也是最早向我介绍其专业原则和实践的人。一个幽默的人
在日常生活中，爱泼斯坦机智、幽默，而且非常乐观。我记得上世纪50年代末，在我们杂志举办的国庆庆祝活动上，他表演了一个小品，扮演一名举重运动员。他身材矮小、体格健壮，看上去确实像个大力士。

在观众面前，他一次次将一个看似沉重的巨大杠铃举过头顶，赢得热烈掌声。但表演接近尾声时，爱泼斯坦开始将杠铃在头顶旋转。他甩得如此用力，以致其中一个杠铃片突然松脱掉落。这时大家才明白，杠铃是纸做的，而杠铃片其实是一个废纸篓，只是巧妙地化了一点妆。无论是讲课还是与人聊天，爱泼斯坦都善于使用生动通俗的语言。

他擅长用贴切而发人深省的类比来解释复杂的思想和日常现象。他关于英语用法和翻译艺术的许多趣闻轶事广为人知。我想回忆几件我亲身经历的事。1988年，我陪同一位西班牙记者访问北京。爱泼斯坦的妻子黄浣碧安排我和那位记者在北京友谊宾馆采访爱泼斯坦。

我们谈得很愉快。后来爱泼斯坦见到我时，开玩笑地说：“你看，我就像琉璃厂（现多称琉璃厂街，北京著名的文化街）的一件老古董。每当有外国客人来参观，我就被拿出来给他们看。”
1996年10月9日，我应邀出席在天安门广场东侧中国历史博物馆（现中国国家博物馆）举行的纪念国际纵队成立60周年仪式。出席者中有保加利亚医生扬托·卡内蒂和英国教授大卫·柯鲁克，他们都是国际纵队的老战士，后来到中国参加中国人民抗日战争。爱泼斯坦也在场，他是最了解国际纵队与中国历史渊源的人之一。

仪式结束后，我搀扶年迈的爱泼斯坦走下博物馆长长的台阶。我们边走边聊，他不停地抱怨自己的腿：“我这两条腿真讨厌！它们就像某些官员——只能上，不能下。”
那天，我坐爱泼斯坦的车回家。一路上大家有说有笑。黄浣碧指着我说：“这是我们杂志的小许，不过现在该叫他老许了。”爱泼斯坦立刻纠正她：“不对，不对！

为什么要叫他老许？应该称他许老！”
一位拯救者
1995年6月，有关部门出人意料地决定停办《今日中国》（原《中国建设》）西班牙文版，理由是拉丁美洲形势发生了变化。西班牙文版的同事们对这一决定都感到困惑不解。自1960年创刊以来，西班牙文版已成功运作35年，受到拉美各国读者的热烈欢迎，并获得社会各界的好评。

那时，它已成为拉美人民了解当代中国的重要窗口，也是促进中拉人民沟通与相互理解的桥梁。中国针对该地区的对外传播工作显然需要加强，而不是削弱，更不应停办。西班牙文版的同事们无法理解这一决定，联名写信给上级部门，要求解释并申诉。信通过该版负责人转交给了爱泼斯坦。当爱泼斯坦得知西班牙文版即将停办时，既震惊又悲痛。

他不理解为什么作出如此重大的决定却不征求他的意见。作为杂志的名誉主编和当时的中国人民政治协商会议（政协）常务委员会委员，他觉得自己不能袖手旁观。他立即写信给刚刚访问拉美归来的时任政协主席李瑞环。在信中，爱泼斯坦指出拉美形势发展良好，那里有很多工作要做，中国在该地区的传播工作应当扩大，而不是缩减。

爱泼斯坦还强调，《中国建设》（现《今日中国》）是在时任总理周恩来和中国前名誉主席、中国革命先驱孙中山先生夫人宋庆龄的亲自关注和直接支持下创办和发展起来的。作为杂志的创始人之一，他感到有责任向国家领导人报告情况，不辜负他们对刊物的信任。与此同时，经过西班牙文版同事们的奔走呼吁，外交部、中共中央对外联络部、对外贸易经济合作部（现商务部）和文化部（现文化和旅游部）都呼吁保留该版本。当年夏天，中国驻拉美国家大使在北京开会时也发出了类似呼吁。

经过两个月的共同努力和强烈呼吁重新考虑，上级部门最终推翻了原决定。毫无疑问，爱泼斯坦作为德高望重的人物，在这一结果中发挥了关键作用。历史表明，他致信中央领导并申诉，帮助《今日中国》西班牙文版免于戛然而止。从此，爱泼斯坦与西班牙文版结下了对该刊存续至关重要的缘分。今天，令人欣慰的是，《今日中国》西班牙文版继续蓬勃发展，自创刊初期以来已存续近六十年。

2004年10月，杂志终于完成了本土化工作，在墨西哥和秘鲁设立了海外机构，并安排在当地印刷和发行。这使西班牙文版能够更紧密地根据当地读者的需求和兴趣定制选题和内容，显著提升了其针对性和实效性。回顾往事，我们不禁对爱泼斯坦为我们西班牙文版所做的奉献，以及他在关键时刻拯救该版所发挥的决定性作用，深怀感激。

articles.title: Xi chairs, addresses symposium held by CPC Central Committee for soliciting opinions from non-CPC personages on key resolution
articles.titleCn: 习近平主持中共中央党外人士座谈会并发表重要讲话，就重要决议征求意见
articles.summary: A symposium held by the Communist Party of China (CPC) Central Committee on Aug.
articles.summaryCn: 中共中央于8月21日举行党外人士座谈会，就全面从严治党重大议题的决议草案征求意见，习近平主持并发表重要讲话，强调党要管党、从严治党。

paragraphs.en: A {{0}} held by the Communist Party of China (CPC) Central Committee on Aug. 21 was among earnest endeavors to {{1}} opinions from non-Party {{2}}, including leaders from the central committees of other political parties and the All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce (ACFIC), as well as personages with no party affiliation, on drafting the {{3}} of the CPC Central Committee on certain major issues concerning {{4}} with full and {{5}} Party self-governance. Xi Jinping, general secretary of the CPC Central Committee, {{6}} over the symposium at the Zhongnanhai leadership compound in central Beijing and delivered an important speech. He stressed that to govern the country well, the Party must first govern itself well, and to make the country strong, the Party must first strengthen itself. The longer a party has been in power, the longer the period of peace and prosperity, and the more complex the environment, the more it must {{8}} its {{9}} of potential dangers and remain {{7}} in times of peace, he said, and persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance is to ensure that the CPC remains the strong leadership {{10}} in advancing socialism with Chinese characteristics.
paragraphs.cn: 8月21日，中共中央举行座谈会，认真听取各民主党派中央、全国工商联负责人和无党派人士代表对《中共中央关于坚持全面从严治党若干重大问题的决议》稿的意见和建议。中共中央总书记习近平在北京中南海主持座谈会并发表重要讲话。他强调，治国必先治党，党兴才能国强。党执政时间越长、和平繁荣时期越长、环境越复杂，越要增强忧患意识、居安思危，坚持全面从严治党，确保党始终成为推进中国特色社会主义事业的坚强领导核心。

paragraphs.en: Members of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee Wang Huning, Cai Qi and Li Xi attended the symposium. Those who shared their views and suggestions at the event included Zheng Jianbang, chairman of the Central Committee of the Revolutionary Committee of the Chinese Kuomintang; Ding Zhongli, chairman of the Central Committee of the China Democratic League; Hao Mingjin, chairman of the Central Committee of the China National Democratic Construction Association; Cai Dafeng, chairman of the Central Committee of the China Association for Promoting Democracy; He Wei, chairman of the Central Committee of the Chinese Peasants and Workers Democratic Party; Jiang Zuojun, chairman of the Central Committee of the China Zhi Gong Party; Wu Weihua, chairman of the Central Committee of the Jiusan Society; Su Hui, chairperson of the Central Committee of the Taiwan Democratic Self-Government League; Gao Yunlong, chairman of the ACFIC; and Li Wei, a representative of personages without party affiliation. They expressed full support for the draft resolution, and {{11}} the great {{12}} made in full and rigorous Party self-governance since the 18th CPC National Congress under the strong leadership of the CPC Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core. They agreed that the endeavors have broken new ground in the self-reform of the century-old Party and brought about historic achievements and {{13}} in the cause of the Party and the country, and that the Party and the people have thus seized the historic {{14}} in building a great party and a great country. They also put forward suggestions concerning issues such as further studying and implementing Xi Jinping Thought on Party Building, strengthening the arming of the Party members with its new theories, establishing and practicing a correct understanding of what it means to perform well, providing better political guidance, ensuring simultaneous efforts from both people's {{24}} and the Party's self-reform, optimizing the mechanisms for assessing officials' performance and accountability, improving officials' scientific literacy, strengthening checks and oversight over the exercise of power, telling the CPC's stories in the new era well, and publicizing the great achievements concerning full and rigorous Party self-governance.
paragraphs.cn: 中共中央政治局常委王沪宁、蔡奇、李希出席座谈会。在会上发言并提出建议的有：民革中央主席郑建邦、民盟中央主席丁仲礼、民建中央主席郝明金、民进中央主席蔡达峰、农工党中央主席何维、致公党中央主席蒋作君、九三学社中央主席武维华、台盟中央主席苏辉、全国工商联主席高云龙、无党派人士代表李卫。他们表示完全拥护决议稿，高度评价中共十八大以来，在以习近平同志为核心的中共中央坚强领导下，全面从严治党取得的伟大成就。他们认为，这些努力开辟了百年大党自我革命的新境界，推动党和国家事业取得历史性成就、发生历史性变革，党和人民因此赢得了建设伟大政党、伟大国家的历史主动。他们还就进一步学习贯彻习近平总书记关于党的建设的重要思想、用党的创新理论武装党员、树立和践行正确政绩观、加强政治引领、推动人民监督与党的自我革命同向发力、优化干部考核问责机制、提高干部科学素养、加强对权力运行的制约和监督、讲好新时代中国共产党的故事、宣传全面从严治党伟大成就等问题提出了建议。

paragraphs.en: After carefully listening to the remarks of all participants, Xi delivered an important address. He pointed out that it is an important {{15}} of whole-process people's democracy, especially socialist {{16}} democracy, for the CPC Central Committee to solicit opinions from the central committees of the other political parties, the ACFIC, and personages with no party affiliation on important Party documents and major national principles and policies. In February this year, the CPC Central Committee {{17}} its United Front Work Department with soliciting opinions from non-CPC personages on the agenda of the fifth plenary session of the 20th CPC Central Committee. The opinions and suggestions put forward by all participants in the remarks just now are {{18}}, and will be carefully studied and absorbed by the CPC, Xi said. On behalf of the CPC Central Committee, he expressed his gratitude to all the participants present.
paragraphs.cn: 在认真听取大家发言后，习近平发表了重要讲话。他指出，中共中央就党的重大文件和重大国家方针政策征求各民主党派中央、全国工商联和无党派人士意见，是全过程人民民主特别是社会主义协商民主的重要体现。今年2月，中共中央委托中央统战部就中共二十届五中全会议题征求党外人士意见。习近平说，大家在刚才发言中提出的意见和建议很有价值，中共中央将认真研究吸收。他代表中共中央对各位与会者表示感谢。

paragraphs.en: The key to running China's affairs well lies in the CPC and in exercising full and rigorous Party self-governance, Xi emphasized. Since the Party's 18th National Congress, it has {{19}} advanced full and rigorous Party self-governance, and has grown stronger through revolutionary {{20}}. At the same time, it must be recognized that, as profound changes have taken place in global, national, and Party conditions, full and rigorous Party self-governance faces many new circumstances and new issues. From the strategic perspective of preserving the Party's advanced nature and integrity, {{21}} the Party's governing position, and fulfilling its missions and tasks, it is a must to strengthen confidence, maintain resolve, and earnestly govern and strengthen the Party. Xi pointed out that in persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance, {{22}} efforts must be made to resolve outstanding problems within the Party.
paragraphs.cn: 习近平强调，办好中国的事情，关键在党，关键在全面从严治党。党的十八大以来，党坚定不移推进全面从严治党，在革命性锻造中更加坚强有力。同时也要认识到，随着世情、国情、党情发生深刻变化，全面从严治党面临许多新情况新问题。从保持党的先进性和纯洁性、巩固党的执政地位、完成党的使命任务的战略高度出发，必须坚定信心、保持定力，切实管党治党、强党兴党。习近平指出，坚持全面从严治党，必须下大气力解决党内存在的突出问题。

paragraphs.en: By combining goal-oriented approaches with problem-oriented orientations, the new developments in Party conditions and the new situation confronting Party building can be accurately identified and thoroughly analyzed. In light of new realities, effective countermeasures and solutions must be devised. To resolve the problems existing within the Party, it must, first and foremost, rely on its own efforts to constantly {{23}}, improve, renew, and elevate itself. A symposium held by the Communist Party of China (CPC) Central Committee on Aug. 21 was among earnest endeavors to solicit opinions from non-Party dignitaries, including leaders from the central committees of other political parties and the All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce (ACFIC), as well as personages with no party affiliation, on drafting the resolution of the CPC Central Committee on certain major issues concerning persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance.
Xi Jinping, general secretary of the CPC Central Committee, presided over the symposium at the Zhongnanhai leadership compound in central Beijing and delivered an important speech. He stressed that to govern the country well, the Party must first govern itself well, and to make the country strong, the Party must first strengthen itself. The longer a party has been in power, the longer the period of peace and prosperity, and the more complex the environment, the more it must heighten its awareness of potential dangers and remain vigilant in times of peace, he said, and persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance is to ensure that the CPC remains the strong leadership core in advancing socialism with Chinese characteristics.
Members of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee Wang Huning, Cai Qi and Li Xi attended the symposium.
Those who shared their views and suggestions at the event included Zheng Jianbang, chairman of the Central Committee of the Revolutionary Committee of the Chinese Kuomintang; Ding Zhongli, chairman of the Central Committee of the China Democratic League; Hao Mingjin, chairman of the Central Committee of the China National Democratic Construction Association; Cai Dafeng, chairman of the Central Committee of the China Association for Promoting Democracy; He Wei, chairman of the Central Committee of the Chinese Peasants and Workers Democratic Party; Jiang Zuojun, chairman of the Central Committee of the China Zhi Gong Party; Wu Weihua, chairman of the Central Committee of the Jiusan Society; Su Hui, chairperson of the Central Committee of the Taiwan Democratic Self-Government League; Gao Yunlong, chairman of the ACFIC; and Li Wei, a representative of personages without party affiliation.
They expressed full support for the draft resolution, and appreciated the great achievements made in full and rigorous Party self-governance since the 18th CPC National Congress under the strong leadership of the CPC Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core. They agreed that the endeavors have broken new ground in the self-reform of the century-old Party and brought about historic achievements and transformations in the cause of the Party and the country, and that the Party and the people have thus seized the historic initiative in building a great party and a great country.
They also put forward suggestions concerning issues such as further studying and implementing Xi Jinping Thought on Party Building, strengthening the arming of the Party members with its new theories, establishing and practicing a correct understanding of what it means to perform well, providing better political guidance, ensuring simultaneous efforts from both people's oversight and the Party's self-reform, optimizing the mechanisms for assessing officials' performance and accountability, improving officials' scientific literacy, strengthening checks and oversight over the exercise of power, telling the CPC's stories in the new era well, and publicizing the great achievements concerning full and rigorous Party self-governance.
After carefully listening to the remarks of all participants, Xi delivered an important address. He pointed out that it is an important manifestation of whole-process people's democracy, especially socialist consultative democracy, for the CPC Central Committee to solicit opinions from the central committees of the other political parties, the ACFIC, and personages with no party affiliation on important Party documents and major national principles and policies. In February this year, the CPC Central Committee entrusted its United Front Work Department with soliciting opinions from non-CPC personages on the agenda of the fifth plenary session of the 20th CPC Central Committee.
The opinions and suggestions put forward by all participants in the remarks just now are valuable, and will be carefully studied and absorbed by the CPC, Xi said. On behalf of the CPC Central Committee, he expressed his gratitude to all the participants present.
The key to running China's affairs well lies in the CPC and in exercising full and rigorous Party self-governance, Xi emphasized. Since the Party's 18th National Congress, it has unswervingly advanced full and rigorous Party self-governance, and has grown stronger through revolutionary tempering. At the same time, it must be recognized that, as profound changes have taken place in global, national, and Party conditions, full and rigorous Party self-governance faces many new circumstances and new issues. From the strategic perspective of preserving the Party's advanced nature and integrity, consolidating the Party's governing position, and fulfilling its missions and tasks, it is a must to strengthen confidence, maintain resolve, and earnestly govern and strengthen the Party.
Xi pointed out that in persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance, tenacious efforts must be made to resolve outstanding problems within the Party. By combining goal-oriented approaches with problem-oriented orientations, the new developments in Party conditions and the new situation confronting Party building can be accurately identified and thoroughly analyzed. In light of new realities, effective countermeasures and solutions must be devised. To resolve the problems existing within the Party, it must, first and foremost, rely on its own efforts to constantly purify, improve, renew, and elevate itself. It must also rely on the support of the people by willingly accepting their oversight, humbly listening to their criticisms, and converting their support into a powerful driving force for persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance.
Advancing the great new project of Party building in the new era requires a systematic approach, with an emphasis on forward-looking thinking, overall planning and holistic implementation, Xi underlined. It is essential to thoroughly study and apply the Thought on Party Building in the new era, uphold and strengthen the centralized, unified leadership of the Party Central Committee, remain unwavering in applying strict principles, improve the system of exercising full and rigorous Party self-governance, and take strengthening the Party politically as the overarching principle to advance Party building on all fronts.
It is necessary to work in concert to enhance Party consciousness, improve Party conduct, and tighten Party discipline, and integrate conduct improvement and discipline enforcement with anti-corruption measures. The management of personnel, the handling of affairs and the exercise of power must be combined. Efforts to temper the Party spirit, enhance capabilities and purify the political ecosystem must also go hand in hand. It is imperative to adhere to a top-down approach, starting with leading officials and holding them to strict standards. Education, management and oversight must be strengthened to guide Party members and officials to guard against all temptations when alone, and identify the unhealthy from the outset. They should also practice self-respect, self-reflection, self-alertness and self-motivation.
Xi noted the need to uphold, develop and improve China's new type of political party system. He expressed the hope that non-CPC political parties, the ACFIC, and personages without party affiliation will remain true to the original aspiration of multiparty cooperation, firmly uphold the leadership of the CPC, and continuously consolidate the common ideological and political foundation. He also called on them to actively offer advice and suggestions on state affairs, fulfill their role in democratic oversight, and serve as good advisers and assistants of the CPC.
Yin Li, Shi Taifeng, Li Ganjie, Li Shulei, Li Hongzhong, He Lifeng, Chen Wenqing, Liu Jinguo, Wang Xiaohong, Zhang Shengmin, Wu Zhenglong, Mu Hong, and leading officials of relevant departments of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council attended the event.
Also present at the symposium were non-CPC figures including Shao Hong, He Baoxiang, Wang Guangqian, Qin Boyong, Zhu Yongxin, Yang Zhen, Zhang Endi, An Lijia, and Wu Chen.

articles.title: Chinese technology powers Kenya's packaging industry

articles.summary: In Kenya's lakeside city of Kisumu, Chinese-made machinery is helping local manufacturers improve efficiency, expand production and meet growing demand for packaging materials.
articles.summaryCn: 中国工业技术正帮助肯尼亚基苏木的包装企业提高效率、扩大生产，并推动当地制造业发展。

paragraphs.en: As manufacturers and buyers gather for the China International Import Expo (CIIE) in China, Chinese industrial technology is {{0}} production thousands of kilometers away in Africa. In Kenya's lakeside city of Kisumu, Chinese-made machinery is helping local manufacturers improve {{1}}, expand production and meet growing demand for packaging materials. From food processing and agriculture to pharmaceuticals and retail, packaging plays a {{2}} role in protecting products, {{3}} quality and connecting manufacturers with consumers. At IBS Pack Prints, a packaging company established in 2023, Chinese technology is driving efforts to strengthen local manufacturing and support businesses across western Kenya. paragraphs.cn: 当制造商和采购商齐聚中国参加中国国际进口博览会（CIIE）之际，中国的工业技术正在数千公里之外的非洲改变着生产面貌。在肯尼亚湖畔城市基苏木，中国制造的机械正帮助当地制造商提高效率、扩大生产，并满足对包装材料日益增长的需求。从食品加工、农业到制药和零售，包装在保护产品、保持品质以及连接制造商与消费者方面发挥着至关重要的作用。在成立于2023年的包装公司IBS Pack Prints，中国技术正推动着加强本地制造业、支持肯尼亚西部企业的努力。2026年11月2日，肯尼亚基苏木IBS Pack Prints的包装机器。

Africa
Chinese machinery drives local production
IBS Pack Prints was established to address a {{4}} of packaging suppliers in western Kenya, a region with {{5}} tea factories, bakeries and agricultural processing businesses. Beatrice Omari, the company's administration director, says the investment was intended to bring packaging production closer to manufacturers in the Nyanza and Western regions. "The director had a vision of polythene packaging because, in this region, we only have one in Eldoret, so we wanted to ensure at least this side is covered," Omari said. Today, Chinese machinery forms the {{6}} of the factory's operations, handling printing, processing and cutting of packaging materials. "Actually, 99% of the machines are from China.
paragraphs.cn:

paragraphs.en: Also, the raw materials are from China, like CPP and PET," Omari said, adding that other materials are sourced from Saudi Arabia. The cooperation extends beyond equipment supply. Chinese engineers traveled to Kenya to install and {{7}} the machinery, ensuring production systems were {{8}} before handing them over to local workers. "They shipped the machines and also sent their mechanical engineers, who installed every machine and ensured the machines were working before they left the country," she explained. paragraphs.cn: 此外，原材料也来自中国，比如CPP和PET，”奥马里说，并补充说其他材料来自沙特阿拉伯。合作不仅限于设备供应。中国工程师前往肯尼亚安装和调试机器，确保生产系统在移交给当地工人之前能够正常运行。“他们运送了机器，还派来了机械工程师，他们安装了每台机器，并确保机器在离开该国之前正常运转，”她解释道。这项投资增强了当地的生产能力，同时减少了该地区企业从遥远供应商采购所有包装的需求。

As manufacturers and buyers gather for the China International Import Expo (CIIE) in China, Chinese industrial technology is transforming production thousands of kilometers away in Africa.
In Kenya's lakeside city of Kisumu, Chinese-made machinery is helping local manufacturers improve efficiency, expand production and meet growing demand for packaging materials.
From food processing and agriculture to pharmaceuticals and retail, packaging plays a vital role in protecting products, preserving quality and connecting manufacturers with consumers.
At IBS Pack Prints, a packaging company established in 2023, Chinese technology is driving efforts to strengthen local manufacturing and support businesses across western Kenya.
Packaging machines at IBS Pack Prints in Kisumu, Kenya, November 2, 2026. 
 Africa
Chinese machinery drives local production
IBS Pack Prints was established to address a shortage of packaging suppliers in western Kenya, a region with numerous tea factories, bakeries and agricultural processing businesses.
Beatrice Omari, the company's administration director, says the investment was intended to bring packaging production closer to manufacturers in the Nyanza and Western regions.
"The director had a vision of polythene packaging because, in this region, we only have one in Eldoret, so we wanted to ensure at least this side is covered," Omari said.
Today, Chinese machinery forms the backbone of the factory's operations, handling printing, processing and cutting of packaging materials.
"Actually, 99% of the machines are from China. Also, the raw materials are from China, like CPP and PET," Omari said, adding that other materials are sourced from Saudi Arabia.
The cooperation extends beyond equipment supply. Chinese engineers traveled to Kenya to install and commission the machinery, ensuring production systems were operational before handing them over to local workers.
"They shipped the machines and also sent their mechanical engineers, who installed every machine and ensured the machines were working before they left the country," she explained.
The investment has strengthened local production capacity while reducing the need for businesses in the region to source all their packaging from distant suppliers.
Manufacturing plant at IBS Pack Prints in Kisumu, Kenya, November 2, 2026. 
 Africa
Automation improves efficiency and skills
Inside the factory, machines print, process, and cut packaging materials as workers monitor production and inspect finished products.
The technology has automated tasks previously performed manually, helping improve efficiency and production consistency.
Eric Onyango, the company's Production Manager, says modern machinery has transformed daily operations.
"Nowadays, you just switch on the machine, and the knife will cut. So, that makes work easier, unlike before when we did our work manually," Onyango said.
However, operating advanced equipment requires technical knowledge, particularly when handling different packaging materials and maintaining production systems.
Onyango traveled to China in 2025 to acquire additional machinery as the company sought to expand its operations.
His experience reflects the growing importance of technical cooperation in helping African manufacturers adopt modern industrial technology.
Workers at IBS Pack Prints Machines in Kisumu, Kenya, November 2, 2026. 
 Africa
Beyond improving productivity, such investments create opportunities for workers to develop skills in machine operation, maintenance and quality control.
Packaging strengthens manufacturing value chains
Although packaging is often the final stage of production, it plays a critical role in determining how products reach consumers.
For food processors, it helps preserve quality and protect goods during transportation. For manufacturers and retailers, packaging strengthens branding and product identification.
Henry Koskey, Assistant Branch Manager at Kipchimatt, a retail business in western Kenya, says packaging helps consumers distinguish products from competing brands.
"Packaging identifies items from one manufacturer to another and one company to another," Koskey said.
He cited tea and sugar products from the Kipchimchim Group of Companies as examples of how packaging supports brand recognition.
IBS Pack Prints supplies packaging for bread, tea, sugar, water, ice cream, ice pops and beans, alongside materials used by hospitals and pharmaceutical businesses.
The diversity of its customers highlights the industry's contribution to agriculture, food processing, healthcare and retail.
As Kenya expands local manufacturing and agricultural value addition, reliable packaging will remain essential for businesses seeking to access wider markets.
Henry Koskey, assistant branch manager at Kipchimatt, a retail business in Kericho, Kenya, November 2, 2026. 
 Africa
Challenges and opportunities for growth
Despite technological advances, packaging manufacturers face challenges, including high equipment costs, imported raw materials and unreliable electricity supply.
At IBS Pack Prints, power interruptions can disrupt production and force operators to restart machinery.
"The challenges we are facing mostly occur when there is a power surge. This machine has been made in a way that when the power goes out, everything stops," Onyango explained.
Such disruptions can delay production and increase operating costs, underscoring the importance of reliable infrastructure.
Nevertheless, demand for packaging continues to create opportunities for industrial investment.
For Kenyan businesses, access to Chinese machinery offers opportunities to modernize production, develop technical skills and strengthen manufacturing capacity.
In Kisumu, IBS Pack Prints illustrates how China-Africa trade links are translating into practical industrial development.
As Kenya seeks to expand manufacturing and add value to locally produced goods, packaging is emerging as an important link between technology, production and market access.

articles.title: Fact Check: Colombia gym video falsely linked to earthquake in Xizang
articles.titleCn: 事实核查：哥伦比亚健身房视频被错误关联至西藏地震
articles.summary: A video showing people fleeing a shaking building was falsely shared on social media as footage of the magnitude-7.0 earthquake that struck southwest China's Xizang Autonomous Region in October. Fact Hunter traced the clip to a gym in Pereira, Colombia, filmed in August, nearly two months before the earthquake even happened.
articles.summaryCn: 一段哥伦比亚健身房疏散视频被错误地当作西藏地震画面在社交媒体上传播，事实核查发现该视频早在两个月前就已发布。

paragraphs.en:
A video showing people fleeing a shaking building was {{0}} shared on social media as footage of the {{1}}-7.0 earthquake that struck southwest China's Xizang Autonomous Region in October. Fact Hunter traced the clip to a gym in Pereira, Colombia, filmed in August, nearly two months before the earthquake even happened. While the {{2}} posts only racked up around 81,000 views, the tactic of {{3}} old footage as breaking news is a growing concern. Claim
On October 23, X user @tparon posted a video showing a building shaking as people {{4}} down a staircase. The post claimed it was the first video to emerge from China following the earthquake in Xizang, falsely stating it captured the moment the disaster struck.
paragraphs.cn: 一段显示人们逃离摇晃建筑的视频在社交媒体上被错误地分享为今年10月袭击中国西南部西藏自治区的7.0级地震的画面。事实核查员将这段视频追溯到哥伦比亚佩雷拉的一家健身房，拍摄于8月，比地震发生早了近两个月。虽然这些误导性帖子仅获得约8.1万次浏览，但将旧视频重新包装为突发新闻的手法正日益引发担忧。声称：10月23日，X用户@tparon发布了一段显示建筑摇晃、人们沿楼梯疏散的视频。该帖子声称这是西藏地震后中国传出的第一段视频，错误地称其捕捉到了灾难发生的瞬间。

paragraphs.en:
However, an {{5}} of the video's publication history, location details and the buildings visible in the footage found that it had no connection to the earthquake in China. Fact Hunter finds that the video posted on the social media account appeared on the Instagram account of Meta Gym, a fitness center in Colombia, as early as August 12, 2026. /@tparon
Fact Check
1. The video was published before the Xizang earthquake
The footage appeared on the Instagram account of Meta Gym, a fitness center in Colombia, as early as August 12, 2026, during a period of {{6}} activity in the country. The gym's post identified the location as its Parque Industrial branch.
paragraphs.cn: 然而，对该视频的发布历史、位置细节以及画面中可见建筑的检查发现，其与中国的地震毫无关联。事实核查员发现，该社交媒体账号发布的视频早在2026年8月12日就出现在哥伦比亚健身中心Meta Gym的Instagram账号上。/@tparon 事实核查 1. 该视频在西藏地震之前就已发布 该画面早在2026年8月12日就出现在哥伦比亚健身中心Meta Gym的Instagram账号上，当时该国正处于地震活动期。该健身房的帖子将地点标识为其工业园区分店。

paragraphs.en:
The original video runs about 71 seconds, more than twice the length of the 34-second version later {{7}} on X. Related footage also appeared on YouTube and Facebook that same day, providing further evidence that the clip {{8}} the October earthquake. 2. The gym's sign matches a location in Colombia
Visual details provide another clue to its origin. The building's facade displays a {{9}} sign featuring the word "meta" in white, a yellow letter "B" and the word "GYM" on the right.
paragraphs.cn: 原始视频长约71秒，是后来在X上流传的34秒版本的两倍多。相关画面当天也出现在YouTube和Facebook上，进一步证明该片段早于10月的地震。2. 健身房标志与哥伦比亚某地点吻合 视觉细节提供了另一个来源线索。建筑外立面展示了一个独特的标志，上面有白色的“meta”字样、一个黄色字母“B”以及右侧的“GYM”字样。

paragraphs.en: The logo matches that of Meta Gym, a fitness center in Colombia. The gym's August Instagram post showed the same damaged premises. Its official Facebook account also listed the address of its Parque Industrial branch, {{10}} with the location identified in the Instagram post. A search for Meta Gym in Pereira on Google Maps led to the corresponding building in Google Street View. Its location near Parque Industrial matched the gym's listed address.
paragraphs.cn: 该标志与哥伦比亚健身中心Meta Gym的标志一致。该健身房8月的Instagram帖子显示了同样受损的场所。其官方Facebook账号还列出了其工业园区分店的地址，与Instagram帖子中标识的位置一致。在谷歌地图上搜索佩雷拉的Meta Gym，可在谷歌街景中找到对应的建筑。其靠近工业园区的位置与该健身房列出的地址相符。

paragraphs.en:
Further comparisons showed that the gym's sign, the building's exterior colors and a light-colored multi-storey building to its right were all consistent with images captured by Google Street View in 2024. 3. Daylight conditions contradict the claimed timing
The lighting in the footage also {{11}} the claim that it showed the moment the Xizang earthquake struck. According to monitoring data from the Xizang Earthquake Agency, the magnitude-7.0 earthquake occurred at 10:33 p.m. Beijing time on October 22.
paragraphs.cn: 进一步对比显示，该健身房的标志、建筑外观颜色以及右侧一栋浅色多层建筑均与谷歌街景2024年拍摄的图像一致。3. 日光条件与声称的时间相矛盾 画面中的光线也与该视频显示西藏地震发生瞬间的说法相矛盾。根据西藏地震局的监测数据，7.0级地震发生于北京时间10月22日晚上10点33分。

paragraphs.en:
The video, by contrast, clearly shows daylight conditions. Footage of the earthquake published by Euronews on October 23 showed nighttime conditions when the tremor occurred. A publication and misleading video circulation timeline made by Fact Hunter. 4. How the misleading video spread
The footage circulated in two main waves: first on August 12 and again on October 23.
paragraphs.cn: 相比之下，该视频明显显示的是日光条件。欧洲新闻台10月23日发布的地震画面显示，地震发生时是夜间条件。事实核查员制作的发布与误导性视频传播时间线。4. 误导性视频如何传播 该画面分两波主要传播：先是8月12日，然后是10月23日。

paragraphs.en: After its initial publication by Meta Gym, the video {{12}} on X following the earthquake in Xizang. Accounts including @tparon and @RoyaNewsEnglish shared English-language posts linking it to the disaster, while @LaHoraMX and @larepublica_co circulated Spanish-language versions. The misleading footage also appeared in Japanese- and Hindi-language posts, as well as on TikTok and Instagram. Spanish outlet Libertad Digital {{13}} the original misleading X post in its earthquake report, which brought the footage to a wider audience. Fact Hunter found that X user @chematierra has since deleted the misleading video and issued a correction.
paragraphs.cn: 在Meta Gym首次发布后，该视频在西藏地震后再次出现在X上。包括@tparon和@RoyaNewsEnglish在内的账号分享了将其与灾难关联的英文帖子，而@LaHoraMX和@larepublica_co则传播了西班牙语版本。误导性画面还出现在日语和印地语帖子中，以及TikTok和Instagram上。西班牙媒体Libertad Digital在其地震报道中嵌入了原始的误导性X帖子，使该画面传播给了更广泛的受众。事实核查员发现，X用户@chematierra此后删除了该误导性视频并发布了更正。

paragraphs.en:
However, several other accounts left their posts linking the footage to the earthquake in Xizang online. 5. Account analysis
The account that initially drew attention to the footage on October 23, @tparon, had {{14}} 15,500 followers on X. Its profile describes its focus as breaking news, natural disasters, police scanner activity, flights, open-source intelligence and conflicts. It regularly shares updates about events around the world.
paragraphs.cn: 然而，其他几个账号仍将其与西藏地震关联的帖子保留在网上。5. 账号分析 10月23日最初引起对该画面关注的账号@tparon在X上拥有约15,500名粉丝。其个人简介称其关注突发新闻、自然灾害、警用扫描仪活动、航班、开源情报和冲突。它定期分享世界各地事件的更新。

paragraphs.en:

A video showing people fleeing a shaking building was falsely shared on social media as footage of the magnitude-7.0 earthquake that struck southwest China's Xizang Autonomous Region in October.
Fact Hunter traced the clip to a gym in Pereira, Colombia, filmed in August, nearly two months before the earthquake even happened.
While the misleading posts only racked up around 81,000 views, the tactic of repackaging old footage as breaking news is a growing concern.
Claim
On October 23, X user @tparon posted a video showing a building shaking as people evacuated down a staircase.
The post claimed it was the first video to emerge from China following the earthquake in Xizang, falsely stating it captured the moment the disaster struck.
However, an examination of the video's publication history, location details and the buildings visible in the footage found that it had no connection to the earthquake in China.
Fact Hunter finds that the video posted on the social media account appeared on the Instagram account of Meta Gym, a fitness center in Colombia, as early as August 12, 2026. /@tparon
Fact Check
1. The video was published before the Xizang earthquake
The footage appeared on the Instagram account of Meta Gym, a fitness center in Colombia, as early as August 12, 2026, during a period of seismic activity in the country.
The gym's post identified the location as its Parque Industrial branch. The original video runs about 71 seconds, more than twice the length of the 34-second version later circulated on X.
Related footage also appeared on YouTube and Facebook that same day, providing further evidence that the clip predated the October earthquake.
2. The gym's sign matches a location in Colombia
Visual details provide another clue to its origin.
The building's facade displays a distinctive sign featuring the word "meta" in white, a yellow letter "B" and the word "GYM" on the right. The logo matches that of Meta Gym, a fitness center in Colombia.
The gym's August Instagram post showed the same damaged premises. Its official Facebook account also listed the address of its Parque Industrial branch, consistent with the location identified in the Instagram post.
A search for Meta Gym in Pereira on Google Maps led to the corresponding building in Google Street View. Its location near Parque Industrial matched the gym's listed address.
Further comparisons showed that the gym's sign, the building's exterior colors and a light-colored multi-storey building to its right were all consistent with images captured by Google Street View in 2024.
3. Daylight conditions contradict the claimed timing
The lighting in the footage also contradicts the claim that it showed the moment the Xizang earthquake struck.
According to monitoring data from the Xizang Earthquake Agency, the magnitude-7.0 earthquake occurred at 10:33 p.m. Beijing time on October 22.
The video, by contrast, clearly shows daylight conditions. Footage of the earthquake published by Euronews on October 23 showed nighttime conditions when the tremor occurred.
A publication and misleading video circulation timeline made by Fact Hunter. 
4. How the misleading video spread
The footage circulated in two main waves: first on August 12 and again on October 23.
After its initial publication by Meta Gym, the video resurfaced on X following the earthquake in Xizang. Accounts including @tparon and @RoyaNewsEnglish shared English-language posts linking it to the disaster, while @LaHoraMX and @larepublica_co circulated Spanish-language versions.
The misleading footage also appeared in Japanese- and Hindi-language posts, as well as on TikTok and Instagram. Spanish outlet Libertad Digital embedded the original misleading X post in its earthquake report, which brought the footage to a wider audience.
Fact Hunter found that X user @chematierra has since deleted the misleading video and issued a correction. However, several other accounts left their posts linking the footage to the earthquake in Xizang online.
5. Account analysis
The account that initially drew attention to the footage on October 23, @tparon, had approximately 15,500 followers on X.
Its profile describes its focus as breaking news, natural disasters, police scanner activity, flights, open-source intelligence and conflicts. It regularly shares updates about events around the world.

Background

The earthquake killed 16 people and injured 76, according to local government.
Verdict: out of context
The video is unrelated to the October 2026 Xizang earthquake. It had been publicly available since at least August 12 and showed an evacuation at Meta Gym's Parque Industrial branch in Pereira, Colombia.
The gym's branding, building and surrounding environment matched the location identified through its social media accounts and Google Street View. The daylight conditions captured in the footage also contradict the nighttime timing of the earthquake in China.
Conclusion
This case illustrates how old footage can be repackaged as breaking news during a major disaster and spread across platforms and languages.
When encountering videos claiming to show the scene of a recent disaster, viewers should check when the footage first appeared, compare identifiable landmarks and verify the location against reliable sources, rather than relying solely on captions or the images themselves.

一位了解会谈情况的官员向路透社透露，伊朗谈判代表周日已在多哈与卡塔尔调解人进行连续第三天的会谈，旨在推动达成结束美以对伊战争的协议。持续的外交努力正值人们日益担忧，11月3日美国中期选举后冲突可能再次升级之际。伊朗外长阿巴斯·阿拉格奇周日表示，正在进行的会谈目的是继续与卡塔尔调解人磋商，并补充说德黑兰已做好“防御和外交”两手准备。阿拉格奇对官方媒体表示，关于“两天提案”的讨论仍在继续，但尚未达成最终结论。卡塔尔半岛电视台援引阿拉格奇的话称，伊朗和卡塔尔谈判代表已制定了一项提案，即在可能与华盛顿达成协议后两天内重新开放霍尔木兹海峡。阿拉格奇在谈到与卡塔尔官员的会谈时说：“我们在此过程中竭尽全力，我们希望对方保持理性，将外交置于其他途径之上。”与此同时，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周六表达了乐观态度，告诉记者与伊朗结束战争的谈判“进展顺利”。但他补充说，仍有一两个目标需要“处理”。此外，美国媒体Axios报道称，特朗普周六与以色列总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡通电话，讨论了何时以及是否加大对伊朗的作战行动。

Axios援引一名美国官员和一名以色列官员的话称，两位领导人讨论了与伊朗谈判的现状，内塔尼亚胡敦促总统在美国中期选举后立即对伊朗发动打击，而特朗普则希望让谈判继续进行。据Axios报道，以色列消息人士称此次通话“艰难”，而美国消息人士称其“直接”。2026年10月24日，货船停泊在伊朗阿巴斯港附近的霍尔木兹海峡。尽管外交努力持续进行，但华盛顿近几天对伊朗的军事行动威胁有所加剧。据《华尔街日报》报道，特朗普周四听取了美国高级军事官员关于对伊朗选项的简报。据《华尔街日报》报道，美国还通知了几个海湾国家，为美国中期选举后可能对伊朗发动的短暂但激烈的军事行动做好准备。

针对日益增长的军事压力，伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队发言人侯赛因·穆赫比周日表示，伊朗军队已确定了一个广阔的战场，以对“敌人”造成损害并实现完全威慑。据半官方的塔斯尼姆通讯社报道，穆赫比称伊朗军队比以往任何时候都更准备好“对敌人做出果断回应”。他还提到最高领袖莫杰塔巴·哈梅内伊最近向高级军事指挥官发出的指示，称领袖的指导方针“开启了战争的新篇章”。穆赫比强调哈梅内伊所说的“与美国的战争没有地理限制”，并表示革命卫队已将识别新的敌方目标和规划在新地理区域开展行动列入议程。另外，革命卫队海军周日宣布，两艘“违规”油轮，包括一艘超级油轮，在过去几小时内在霍尔木兹海峡触雷后发生爆炸并被迫停航。在革命卫队官方新闻媒体Sepah News上发表的一份声明中，海军称这些油轮当时正通过海峡的“未经授权”路线。声明补充说，超级油轮“发生巨大爆炸并正在燃烧”，强调两艘船都关闭了导航和识别系统。
